label: Season
value: Summer only; the trails close in winter under heavy snow
quote: Daral Lake is accessible only during the summer; during the winter, the trails which lead to the lake, are closed due to heavy snowfall.

label: Trek from Gabina Jabba (the favoured trail)
value: Jeep road ends at Gabina Jabba; about 4 to 5 hours on foot
quote: An unmetalled-cum-jeepable road ends at Gabina Jabba where the trekking journey begins.

label: Trek from Bahrain (the other side)
value: About 3 to 4 hours on bare mountains; this side is outside the model
quote: While in summer, it can be accessed from Bahrain in three to four hours of trekking on bare mountains.

label: Elevation (two sources differ)
value: Wikipedia gives 3,505.2 m; the model's surface over the water reads about 3,212 m
quote: at an elevation of 3,505.2 m (11,500 ft)
source: Wikipedia, Daral Lake (fetched Oct 2026); model height from Copernicus DEM

label: Drainage
value: Fed by melting glaciers; the outflow is Daral Khwar, a left tributary of the Swat River
quote: The lake is fed by melting glaciers of the surrounding mountains and gives rise to Daral Khwar which is the main left tributary of Swat River.
